title: India's homegrown Chariot-1 AI models
caption:
India has a new homegrown AI model family: Chariot-1. 🇮🇳
Reports say it includes a language model and a text-to-speech model, with speech in English and 10 Indian languages. The reports do not say if you can try it yet.
